title: 紐約 Freshkills 公園掩埋場復育~Freshkills Park landfill restoration
focus: 掩埋場覆蓋、氣水控制與長期公園管理~Landfill cover, gas/water controls and long-term park stewardship
summary: Freshkills的公園功能建立在掩埋場工程覆蓋與持續監測之上。學徒要把雨水、滲出水、氣體、沉陷和植被畫成分開但互相影響的路徑。~Freshkills park functions above engineered landfill containment and monitoring. Learners separate, then reconnect, stormwater, leachate, gas, settlement and vegetation pathways.

units.title: 覆蓋層水量邊界：覆蓋層水量平衡~Cover-system water balance: Cover-system water balance
units.mechanism: 降雨被分成逕流、蒸散、儲水變化與向下滲漏；綠色覆蓋並不表示滲漏已受控制。本單元在「覆蓋層水量邊界」觀察此因果關係。~Rain partitions into runoff, evapotranspiration, storage change and percolation; green cover does not prove leakage control. Examine this relationship at cover-system water balance.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：P=100、R=30、ET=40、ΔS=10 mm，同一期間。公式 Perc=P-R-ET-ΔS；代入 100-30-40-10 = 20 mm。適用邊界：面積平均帳，未表示襯層缺陷造成的局部滲漏。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: P=100, R=30, ET=40 andΔS=10 mm over the same period. Formula Perc=P-R-ET-ΔS; substitution 100-30-40-10 = 20 mm. Boundary: Area-average ledger; localized leakage through liner defects is not represented.
units.verify: 比較氣象、水位與滲出水流量，檢查季節儲水變化。在離線場景為「覆蓋層水量邊界」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Compare weather, water levels and leachate flow and inspect seasonal storage. Build an offline evidence table for cover-system water balance; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 沉陷破壞排水坡度會造成積水與局部滲漏。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Settlement can reverse drainage slopes, causing ponding and local leakage. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 覆土長滿植物就表示掩埋場已無環境風險。~Vegetated cover means the landfill has no environmental risk.
units.practice: 先點選「覆蓋層水量邊界」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把逕流R改成20 mm，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 30 mm。與基準 20 mm比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the cover-system water balance measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only runoffR to20 mm with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 30 mm. Compare with baseline 20 mm and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 坡面雨水逕流：集水面積與逕流量~Slope stormwater runoff: Catchment area and runoff volume
units.mechanism: 降雨量乘面積提供總水量，以逕流係數近似扣除入滲與其他損失；該係數隨土壤與前期濕度而變。本單元在「坡面雨水逕流」觀察此因果關係。~Rain depth times area gives total water; a runoff coefficient approximates infiltration and other losses and varies with soil and antecedent moisture. Examine this relationship at slope stormwater runoff.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：雨深P=30 mm、集水面積A=10000 m²、C=0.75。公式 V=CPA/1000；代入 0.75*30*10000/1000 = 225 m³。適用邊界：事件總量近似，不能推得尖峰流率或管線容量。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: rainP=30 mm, catchmentA=10000 m² andC=0.75. Formula V=CPA/1000; substitution 0.75*30*10000/1000 = 225 m³. Boundary: Event-volume approximation; does not predict peak flow or pipe capacity.
units.verify: 畫屋頂、路面與綠地分區，分別加權C並核對雨量站。在離線場景為「坡面雨水逕流」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Map roofs, pavement and vegetation, weight C separately and check rainfall data. Build an offline evidence table for slope stormwater runoff; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 把mm直接乘m²而未除1000會造成千倍錯誤。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Multiplying mm bym² without dividing by1000 gives a thousandfold error. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 總雨量相同就保證尖峰淹水風險相同。~Equal storm totals guarantee equal peak flood risk.
units.practice: 先點選「坡面雨水逕流」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把C降成0.50，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 150 m³。與基準 225 m³比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the slope stormwater runoff measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only C to0.50 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 150 m³. Compare with baseline 225 m³ and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 排水溝與滯洪退水：退水時間與恢復使用~Ditch and detention drawdown: Drawdown time and return to use
units.mechanism: 暫存水需在下次事件前排空並確認使用條件；退水時間由可用排水流量決定。本單元在「排水溝與滯洪退水」觀察此因果關係。~Stored water needs drawdown before the next event and a check before public use; available discharge governs drawdown time. Examine this relationship at ditch and detention drawdown.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：待排水V=180 m³、定流量Q=15 m³/h。公式 t=V/Q；代入 180/15 = 12 h。適用邊界：固定出流示範；孔口出流隨水頭下降須積分計算。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: stored waterV=180 m³ and constant dischargeQ=15 m³/h. Formula t=V/Q; substitution 180/15 = 12 h. Boundary: Constant-flow illustration; orifice discharge declining with head needs integration.
units.verify: 以水位記錄核對退水曲線，巡查積水與污物後才恢復場地。在離線場景為「排水溝與滯洪退水」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Check the drawdown curve against level data and inspect standing water and debris before reopening. Build an offline evidence table for ditch and detention drawdown; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 出水口被落葉堵塞會延長不可用時間。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Leaf-blocked outlets lengthen unavailable time. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 雨停後場地一定立刻可安全使用。~A space is necessarily ready for safe use immediately when rain stops.
units.practice: 先點選「排水溝與滯洪退水」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把Q降成10 m³/h，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 18 h。與基準 12 h比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the ditch and detention drawdown measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only Q to10 m³/h with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 18 h. Compare with baseline 12 h and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 掩埋氣收集支線：掩埋氣體收集與逸散~Landfill-gas collection laterals: Landfill-gas capture and fugitive loss
units.mechanism: 抽取井收集的氣體只占產氣一部分；必須區分產生、收集、氧化與逸散。本單元在「掩埋氣收集支線」觀察此因果關係。~Collection wells capture only part of generated gas; distinguish generation, collection, oxidation and fugitive emissions. Examine this relationship at landfill-gas collection laterals.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：假想甲烷產生1000 Nm³/d、收集率0.70。公式 Vuncaptured=Vgenerated(1-fcapture)；代入 1000*(1-0.70) = 300 Nm³/d。適用邊界：未收集不全等於排到大氣，覆土氧化需另外估計。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: hypothetical methane generation1000 Nm³/d and capture fraction0.70. Formula Vuncaptured=Vgenerated(1-fcapture); substitution 1000*(1-0.70) = 300 Nm³/d. Boundary: Uncaptured gas is not all atmospheric emission; cover oxidation needs separate estimation.
units.verify: 結合井場流量、表面巡測與覆層資料，不只看總管抽氣量。在離線場景為「掩埋氣收集支線」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Combine well-field flow, surface surveys and cover information rather than header flow alone. Build an offline evidence table for landfill-gas collection laterals; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 過度抽氣引入空氣可能改變氣體品質與火災風險。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Excess extraction can draw in air, changing gas quality and fire risk. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 收集總管沒有讀到甲烷就表示地下沒有甲烷。~No methane reading in the collection header means none exists underground.
units.practice: 先點選「掩埋氣收集支線」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把收集率改成0.80，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 200 Nm³/d。與基準 300 Nm³/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the landfill-gas collection laterals measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only capture fraction to0.80 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 200 Nm³/d. Compare with baseline 300 Nm³/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 不均勻沉陷巡測：差異沉陷與地形坡度~Differential-settlement survey: Differential settlement and surface slope
units.mechanism: 兩點差異沉陷改變排水坡度，影響覆層完整性、管線與公共設施；平均沉陷不足以判讀。本單元在「不均勻沉陷巡測」觀察此因果關係。~Differential settlement changes drainage grade and stresses covers, pipes and public facilities; mean settlement is insufficient. Examine this relationship at differential-settlement survey.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：兩點距離L=20 m、差異沉陷Δs=0.10 m。公式 Δslope=100Δs/L；代入 100*0.10/20 = 0.5 %。適用邊界：小變形幾何示範，不是邊坡穩定或地基承載分析。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: point spacingL=20 m and differential settlementΔs=0.10 m. Formula Δslope=100Δs/L; substitution 100*0.10/20 = 0.5 %. Boundary: Small-deformation geometry, not slope stability or foundation capacity analysis.
units.verify: 設置穩定外部基準點，重複測量並查局部裂縫與積水。在離線場景為「不均勻沉陷巡測」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Use a stable external datum, repeat surveys and inspect cracks and ponding. Build an offline evidence table for differential-settlement survey; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 基準點也沉陷會使全部測點看似不動。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~A settling datum can make all monitored points appear stationary. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 只測一個點的高程就能判斷整個覆蓋層完整。~One point elevation proves the whole cover is intact.
units.practice: 先點選「不均勻沉陷巡測」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把差異沉陷改成0.20 m，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 1 %。與基準 0.5 %比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the differential-settlement survey measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only differential settlement to0.20 m with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 1 %. Compare with baseline 0.5 % and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 滲出水輸送能源：提升水頭與電力~Leachate-conveyance energy: Lift head and electrical power
units.mechanism: 泵的輸入功率須供應流量的位能增加及損失；效率下降會使同一輸送服務耗電增加。本單元在「滲出水輸送能源」觀察此因果關係。~Pump input must provide the hydraulic energy increase and losses; lower efficiency increases electricity for the same conveyance service. Examine this relationship at leachate-conveyance energy.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：Q=0.10 m³/s、H=12 m、總效率η=0.72、ρ=1000 kg/m³。公式 P=ρgQH/(1000η)；代入 1000*9.81*0.10*12/(1000*0.72) = 16.35 kW。適用邊界：穩態不可壓縮流，H含管損；不涵蓋起動、水錘與汽蝕。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: Q=0.10 m³/s, H=12 m, total efficiencyη=0.72 and ρ=1000 kg/m³. Formula P=ρgQH/(1000η); substitution 1000*9.81*0.10*12/(1000*0.72) = 16.35 kW. Boundary: Steady incompressible flow with friction included in H; starting, surge and cavitation are excluded.
units.verify: 同步量測流量、進出口壓差與真實功率，勿把視在功率當耗電。在離線場景為「滲出水輸送能源」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Synchronize flow, pressure difference and real-power measurements; do not confuse apparent and real power. Build an offline evidence table for leachate-conveyance energy; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 葉輪磨損或閥門節流會改變工作點，須查泵曲線。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Impeller wear or throttling changes the operating point; inspect the pump curve. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 相同流量下所有泵的耗電都相同。~All pumps consume the same power at equal flow.
units.practice: 先點選「滲出水輸送能源」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把效率降成0.60，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 19.62 kW。與基準 16.35 kW比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the leachate-conveyance energy measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only efficiency to0.60 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 19.62 kW. Compare with baseline 16.35 kW and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 植根與覆蓋層相容：生態廊道與可用棲地~Root/cover compatibility: Ecological corridors and usable habitat
units.mechanism: 綠地面積與真正連通的可用棲地不同；硬質障礙、照明與維護方式影響動植物通行。本單元在「植根與覆蓋層相容」觀察此因果關係。~Green area differs from connected usable habitat; hard barriers, lighting and maintenance affect movement. Examine this relationship at root/cover compatibility.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：廊道長800 m、平均有效寬度12 m。公式 A=Lw；代入 800*12 = 9600 m²。適用邊界：幾何面積近似，不是物種存活率或生態服務價值。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: corridor length800 m and mean effective width12 m. Formula A=Lw; substitution 800*12 = 9600 m². Boundary: Geometric-area approximation, not survival probability or ecosystem-service valuation.
units.verify: 在地圖標斷點，搭配定點觀察確認指定物種是否實際使用。在離線場景為「植根與覆蓋層相容」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Map breaks and use fixed observations to verify use by specified species. Build an offline evidence table for root/cover compatibility; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 廊道被道路切斷時，相同面積仍可能失去連通。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~A road break can destroy connectivity despite unchanged area. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 只要綠地面積增加，所有物種都會受益。~More green area benefits every species.
units.practice: 先點選「植根與覆蓋層相容」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把有效寬度減成8 m，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 6400 m²。與基準 9600 m²比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the root/cover compatibility measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only effective width to8 m with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 6400 m². Compare with baseline 9600 m² and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 草地棲地追蹤：棲地樣區與多樣性指標~Grassland-habitat tracking: Habitat plots and diversity indicators
units.mechanism: Simpson多樣性以物種比例衡量優勢程度；指標增加不等於所有原生物種都恢復。本單元在「草地棲地追蹤」觀察此因果關係。~Simpson diversity measures dominance through species proportions; a larger index does not prove recovery of every native species. Examine this relationship at grassland-habitat tracking.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：四類生物比例0.4、0.3、0.2、0.1。公式 D=1-Σpi²；代入 1-(0.4**2+0.3**2+0.2**2+0.1**2) = 0.7 index。適用邊界：相同採樣方法與努力量；不替代保育物種與外來種調查。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: four taxon proportions0.4,0.3,0.2,0.1. Formula D=1-Σpi²; substitution 1-(0.4**2+0.3**2+0.2**2+0.1**2) = 0.7 index. Boundary: Same sampling method and effort; not a replacement for protected- and invasive-species surveys.
units.verify: 固定樣區、季節與採樣時長，另記棲地連續性與外來種。在離線場景為「草地棲地追蹤」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Fix plots, season and effort and separately record connectivity and invasive species. Build an offline evidence table for grassland-habitat tracking; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 採樣努力量增加會製造看似改善，須對照基線。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Greater sampling effort can mimic improvement; compare with the baseline. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 看到更多物種就可以忽略是否為入侵物種。~More observed species makes invasive status irrelevant.
units.practice: 先點選「草地棲地追蹤」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把分布改成四類各0.25，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 0.75 index。與基準 0.7 index比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the grassland-habitat tracking measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only proportions to four equal0.25 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 0.75 index. Compare with baseline 0.7 index and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 氣水儀表漂移：感測器偏移校正~Gas/water instrument drift: Sensor offset calibration
units.mechanism: 參考標準可辨識偏移；一點校正只能處理固定偏移，斜率誤差須多點標準確認。本單元在「氣水儀表漂移」觀察此因果關係。~A reference reveals offset; one-point correction handles only a constant offset, whereas gain error needs several standards. Examine this relationship at gas/water instrument drift.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：參考值10.0、感測器10.8、樣品原讀值14.2，單位一致。公式 Ccorrected=Craw-(Cstandard_read-Creference)；代入 14.2-(10.8-10.0) = 13.4 sensor unit。適用邊界：假設偏移固定且量程線性；不代替多點校正與漂移追蹤。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: reference10.0, sensor10.8 and raw sample14.2 in the same units. Formula Ccorrected=Craw-(Cstandard_read-Creference); substitution 14.2-(10.8-10.0) = 13.4 sensor unit. Boundary: Constant offset and linear range assumed; multi-point calibration and drift tracking remain necessary.
units.verify: 用第二標準獨立驗證校正後殘差並記錄日期與溫度。在離線場景為「氣水儀表漂移」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Use a second standard to verify corrected residuals independently and record date and temperature. Build an offline evidence table for gas/water instrument drift; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 以同一標準建立又驗證模型會隱藏校正偏差。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Calibrating and validating with the same standard hides bias. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 單點校正可以證明整個量程都沒有誤差。~One-point calibration proves the entire range is error-free.
units.practice: 先點選「氣水儀表漂移」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把樣品原讀值改成16.2，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 15.4 sensor unit。與基準 13.4 sensor unit比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the gas/water instrument drift measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only raw sample to16.2 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 15.4 sensor unit. Compare with baseline 13.4 sensor unit and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 長期控制設備備援：備援與共同失效~Long-term control redundancy: Redundancy and common failures
units.mechanism: 平行備援可降低獨立停機造成的服務中斷，但共同電源、進水或控制器會破壞獨立假設。本單元在「長期控制設備備援」觀察此因果關係。~Parallel redundancy reduces outages from independent failures, but common power, feed or controllers invalidate independence. Examine this relationship at long-term control redundancy.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：兩列各自可用率A=0.95且任一列足以供應示範負載。公式 Asys=1-(1-A)^2；代入 1-(1-0.95)**2 = 0.9975 fraction。適用邊界：僅兩列獨立且容量足夠；不含共同失效或修復時間分布。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: two trains each have availabilityA=0.95 and either meets the hypothetical load. Formula Asys=1-(1-A)^2; substitution 1-(1-0.95)**2 = 0.9975 fraction. Boundary: Two independent adequate-capacity trains only; common failures and repair-time distributions are excluded.
units.verify: 畫故障樹並標出共享設備，測試單列退出時的完整流程。在離線場景為「長期控制設備備援」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Draw a fault tree marking shared assets and replay the process with one train unavailable. Build an offline evidence table for long-term control redundancy; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 兩列共用一個關鍵閥門，該閥失效仍會同時停產。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~A shared critical valve can stop both trains together. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 設備數量加倍就能消除所有停機。~Doubling equipment eliminates every outage.
units.practice: 先點選「長期控制設備備援」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把各列A改成0.90，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 0.99 fraction。與基準 0.9975 fraction比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the long-term control redundancy measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only each train availability to0.90 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 0.99 fraction. Compare with baseline 0.9975 fraction and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

history: NYC Parks介紹Freshkills由掩埋場轉型公園，場址仍包含封蓋及環境控制；開放空間不表示廢棄物已移除或後續管理已結束。~NYC Parks describes the landfill-to-park transformation with continuing cap and environmental controls; public open space does not mean the waste was removed or stewardship ended.
